notes.title: Tiles customization
notes.content:
Version 0.9.8.3 brings following features:

- Tiles customization! Do not like factory tiles? No problem replace them by your beloved ones.

  So far you can replace enemies, but more to come soon!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/0c1ba3bfc0bce31946ff21c514961e6216a7583c.jpg"]



- New wall decoration inside dungeon : god statue.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/34c363f6cb5ad104aef557e53c2fc5fdb71b36ff.jpg"]



- Legendary Purifier sword now must be merged by a crafting recipe out of three pieces. 

- Some fixes (e.g. mini rats and spiders are back!)

notes.title: Merchant inventory with tabs, new spell and more
notes.content:
- Merchant has now inventory with tabs!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/b7c656a1ff77387bbd4f45319c44aa63aab14100.png"]

- changed outer world's border walls

- new Scroll/Book: Mirror Illusion – Summons a clone of yourself to confuse enemies.
- Resist are now NOT percentage (easy comparison to melee damage!)

- Game speed enhanced (average FPS on my PC ~400 see right upper corner)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/4abfdbb1d228b59523fbf782241c1386f61a3182.png"]

notes.title: Controller support!
notes.content:
Version 0.9.5.12 features:

- Controller support!!!, it was quite a task as game was intentionally optimized to be played by mouse+keyboard. After two months of hard work playing with gamepad is now a comparable experience to mouse+keyboard. 
- Playing using only a keyboard is also possible.
- Options->Keys redesigned - a dedicated dialog is shown when assigning a key
- New scroll/book: Weaken - reduce enemy statistics: Strength, Defense, Dexterity, Magic, Health
- some small fixes

notes.title: New spell, quick equipment comparer, and more
notes.content:
Features:
- Currently equipped item can now be shown for easy comparison using a dedicated key
- New scroll/book: Gravity Crush - slams enemies into the ground, dealing damage and (possibly) stunning them
- Player can change the book assigned to Mage class at the game start
- Events log dialog showing all events that happened during game's session added
- Achievements related to abilities were now working fine


 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/caa7db26f7fef30a7bddd47e143065f7ea3a3dd0.jpg

notes.title: New books and scrolls
notes.content:
Version 0.9.2.0

- some enemies resist now fixed at certain (high) value not depending on enemy's level
- poison effect and bleeding effect now last longer
- Dexterity stat contributes to Chance To Melee Hit
- Mage class gets a book at the game start

- Two of spells proposed by user siren 
Offensive Spell: Blood Bolt - Costs HP instead of mana but deals massive damage to enemies.
Healing and Restoration Spell: Mana Conversion – Converts excess mana into health.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210932/1d55dc5e28f0be3531ab4a428683928311f623a0.png

notes.title: Wawel Dragon quest + boss added
notes.content:
